suites.title: Phase 5 Use Case E2E Suite (UC-01 through UC-06)

specs.title: UC-01-MAIN: Lab User submits valid request -> appears in Pending & persisted in DB
UC-01-ALT-1: Raised minimum user threshold (3) allows submit with 2 buddies
UC-01-ALT-2: Buddy sees shared Pending request in read-only mode without Edit/Delete
UC-01-EXC-1: Submitting with 0 buddies shows minimum-user boundary error and persists nothing
UC-01-EXC-2: Submitting past start_time shows time-guard error and persists nothing
UC-02-MAIN: Creator views Pending/Approved buckets and edits own Pending request
UC-02-ALT-1: Unrelated user dashboard excludes other users requests
UC-02-ALT-2: Area reviewer edits Pending request without approving/denying keeps Pending
UC-02-EXC-1: Unrelated user edit POST is rejected with authorization error
UC-02-EXC-2: Edit attempt on Approved request hides submit controls and rejects POST
UC-03-MAIN: Creator confirms delete -> soft-deleted in DB & removed from UI
UC-03-ALT-1: Dismissing confirm dialog cancels delete and preserves request
UC-03-ALT-2: Soft-deleted request is absent from Reviewer queue
UC-03-EXC-1: Non-creator delete URL returns HTTP 400 and preserves request
UC-03-EXC-2: Delete attempt on Approved request returns HTTP 400 and preserves record
UC-04-MAIN: Facility Reviewer approves Pending request -> Approved UI & grants persisted
UC-04-ALT-1: Area-only reviewer (non-facility-manager) approves request & generates grants
UC-04-ALT-2: Reviewer start-time override allows approving request whose start_time has passed
UC-04-EXC-1: Non-reviewer submitting approve_request POST key cannot self-approve
UC-04-EXC-2: Re-reviewing already Approved request hides Approve/Deny and blocks duplicate grants
UC-05-MAIN: Reviewer denies Pending request -> Denied UI & 0 grants persisted
UC-05-ALT-1: Requester views Denied request with reviewer name and no Edit/Delete buttons
UC-05-ALT-2: Dismissing Deny confirmation dialog keeps request Pending
UC-05-EXC-1: Requester edit POST on Denied request is rejected
UC-05-EXC-2: Requester delete on Denied request returns HTTP 400
UC-06-MAIN: Loading dashboard auto-expires past-due Pending & Facility Manager exports CSV
UC-06-ALT-1: Lab User triggers auto-expire and Export button is hidden
UC-06-ALT-2: Soft-deleted request is excluded from CSV export and Expired bucket
UC-06-EXC-1: Lab User direct access to /export_access_requests/ is denied
UC-06-EXC-2: Edit attempt on auto-Expired request is rejected with non-pending error

suites.title: Phase 6 Defensive Security — Automated Role Access Checks

specs.title: SEC-RBAC-01 (Allowed): Lab User can create own PENDING temporary access request
SEC-RBAC-02 (Denied): Lab User cannot self-approve own request via forged approve_request POST key
SEC-RBAC-03 (Denied): Unrelated Lab User cannot edit another users PENDING request
SEC-RBAC-04 (Denied): Lab User is denied access to CSV export (/export_access_requests/)
SEC-RBAC-05 (Allowed): Facility Manager / Reviewer can approve PENDING request and export CSV
SEC-RBAC-06 (Denied): Facility Reviewer cannot delete another users PENDING request
SEC-RBAC-07 (Allowed): Area-only reviewer (non-staff) can view and deny area PENDING request
SEC-RBAC-08 (Denied): Unauthenticated anonymous user redirected to /login/ for all routes

suites.title: Phase 5 Usability, Error-Guidance & Keyboard Navigation Suite

specs.title: USA-WF1-ERR-KBD: Business-rule error guidance + recovery + keyboard-only navigation & submit
USA-WF2-TASK: Facility Reviewer completes approval task & sees Approved confirmation
